spec_match.rationale: Directly demonstrates CSS Scroll Snap Module Level 1 scroll-snap-type: pair mandatory vs both mandatory on a staggered 2D scroll container where Card A (40, 260) and Card B (260, 40) create an empty phantom cross-axis intersection at (40, 40).

interactive.rationale: Users can switch between pair mandatory, both mandatory, and pair proximity, trigger test scrolls toward the phantom intersections (40, 40) and (260, 260) or individual cards, and inspect live (scrollLeft, scrollTop) telemetry.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the feature index description of a staggered 2D canvas comparing both mandatory phantom intersections against pair mandatory single-element snapping.

edge_cases.rationale: Includes both top-left (40, 40) and bottom-right (260, 260) cross-axis phantom intersections as well as an honest coupled-pair simulator fallback when CSSScrollSnapTypePair is not enabled.

references.rationale: Links to chromestatus.com/feature/5124378896498688, the CSS Scroll Snap 1 specification, and the explainer.

conformance.rationale: Probes CSS.supports('scroll-snap-type', 'pair mandatory') and getComputedStyle(scroller).scrollSnapType serialization.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified live scrollport positions and fallback telemetry readout with zero console or network errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Emits showcaseTelemetry assertions for the CSS.supports probe and updates the live measurement table on scroll and mode switches.

design_system.rationale: Strictly uses CSS custom properties from /public/styles.css with zero raw hex or rgba literals and explicit button background/color pairs.

accessibility.rationale: All controls have min-height: 44px and accessible labels, pre block is keyboard-focusable with tabindex=0, and live-readout uses aria-live=polite.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Responsive grid and bounded 2D scrollport container prevent page-level horizontal overflow on both 360x740 mobile and 1280x800 desktop viewports.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Configure scroll-snap-type on the scroll container and scroll-snap-align on child targets, and reflect active snap state in the accessibility tree.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied scroll-snap-align: start on staggered 2D cards and synchronized scrollport coordinates to an aria-live output and telemetry table.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Provide explicit keyboard-operable jump controls alongside scroll-snap containers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Added 44px target buttons for Card A, Card B, Card C, and both phantom coordinates.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Ensure non-visual equivalents for spatial state changes and visible focus indicators.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Added aria-live=polite readout and tabular coordinate classification for screen reader users.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group related radio controls in a fieldset with a legend and 44px hit targets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Grouped scroll-snap-type radio controls inside a semantic fieldset/legend with min-height: 44px labels.

summary: Canonical comparison of scroll-snap-type: both mandatory vs pair mandatory on a staggered 2D canvas, exposing how independent axis snapping lands on empty (40, 40) phantom coordinates while pair snaps both axes to a single element.
